result.boundary: This is an exact positive internal penalty/filter on the executable finite Spin(10) carrier. It does not by itself construct a relativistic chiral fermion measure, prove anomaly cancellation, select the E8 (27,3) rather than conjugate shell, derive the portal coefficient, protect this high-dimension EFT operator, or prove that the gapped block decouples in a local continuum theory.
result.diagonal_action: For even Hesse transformations use the identity on the Spin(10) carrier; for the odd CP/reflection coset use Ad_R. Then W -> eps W and Chi -> eps Chi, so W Chi is invariant. The action-level diagonal symmetry is exact in the adjoint/projective sense.

flavor.group: W(D3) ~= S4 in the signed-permutation realization, order 24
flavor.sign_character: permutation parity; A4 is the even kernel
flavor.theorem: No nonzero polynomial carrying the odd S4/A4 sign character exists below Bloch degree 6. At degree 6 the sign-isotypic space is one-dimensional and generated by W. Since each Bloch coordinate is bilinear in the Hesse doublet, W has field degree 12.

result.minimal_portal: eta W Chi is the lowest-Bloch-degree polynomial gauge-invariant portal that compensates the odd flavor sign character; W is forced up to invariant factors by the explicit degree-0..6 sign-projector computation.
result.positive_filter: H_gap=lambda[(15/343) rho^6 I + W Chi]^2, lambda>0
result.residual_symmetry: The even A4 flavor subgroup acts without an internal Pin flip and preserves each W-sign orbit. The odd coset exchanges the two vacuum orbits and, through R, exchanges the two Weyl kernels.

spin10.pin_lift: R=i Gamma_10 = certified two-tick clock G^2
spin10.projective_boundary: The odd lift is projective on spinors because R^2=-I, but its adjoint action is an honest Z2 automorphism. No claim is made that the flavor S4 and Spin(10) Pin lift are the same microscopic group.
spin10.so10_normalizer: R fixes bivectors Gamma_i Gamma_j with i,j<10 and negates the nine bivectors containing Gamma_10; hence it normalizes the full so(10) bivector algebra.

result.vacuum_theorem: At every one of the 24 Pass11600 Hesse minima, H_gap is exactly 4 lambda (15/343)^2 rho^12 times one Weyl projector and vanishes on the other 16-dimensional Weyl block. The 12 CP-conjugate vacua exchange which chirality is the kernel.
